metadata.title: केकड़े की चटपटी चटनी | Crab Chutney | Boro Food |Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
In this special episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we take you to the vibrant heart of Assam, where the Bodo community shares the secrets of making Kangkrai Bathwn (Crab Chutney).This dish, known for its smoky, spicy, and rich flavors, is made by blending smoked crab paste with fresh chillies, ginger, garlic, and a pinch of salt—creating a perfect balance of heat and depth.
This episode isn’t just about food — it’s about connecting with nature, preserving ancient culinary practices, and celebrating the rich heritage of the Bodo people.
👉 Don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe for more soulful stories and recipes from the tribal heartlands of India!
